chapter.verse: Ka tanote aw, mawhna na bawl loh nading uh cihna tawh hih thute note' kiangah hong gelh ka hi hi. Ahi zongin mi khatpeuh in mawhna a bawl leh Pa' kiangah taangmi thusung ding khat, midik Jesu Khris i nei hi.
Amah pen i mawhnate a mai nading mawhphelna thu hi a, ei teng' ai bek hilo-in leitung bup' ai ahi hi.
Amah a theician ta i hihlam, hih bangin i kithei ding hi: Ama' thupiakte i zuih ciangin amah a theician ta i hi hi.
“Pasian ka thei ta hi,” ci napi ama' thupiakte a zui lo peuhpeuh zuauphuak hi a, ama' sungah thumaan thutak om lo hi.
Ahi zongin ama' thu a zui peuhpeuh pen ama' sungah Pasian' itna a cingtaak takpi ta ahi hi. Pasian' sungah om i hihlam, hih bangin i kithei ding hi:
Pasian' sungah ka omkip hi a kici peuhpeuh Khris' nuntak bangin a nuntak ding ahi hi.
Kong itte aw, note' tunga kong gelh pen thupiakna a thak hilo a, a kipatcil pan na neih uh thupiakna a lui pen mah ahi hi. Tua thupiakna lui pen na zak khitsa uh thu ahi hi.
Tua kawm mahin thupiakna a thak khat zong hong gelh ka hi veve hi. Khuamial veng ta-in khuavak taktak taang khinta ahih manin tua thupiakna thak pen ama' sung leh note' sungah a thak hi takpi hi.
Khuavak sungah ka om ci napi a sanggamte a mudah peuhpeuh khuamial sungah a om lai ahi hi,
A sanggamte a it peuhpeuh khuavak sungah a omkip hi a, ama' sungah palkhaktheih thu om lo hi.
Ahi zongin a sanggamte a mudah peuhpeuh khuamial sungah a om, khuamial sungah a kalsuan hi a, khuamial in a mitte khuamulosak ahih manin ama' manawhna lam nangawn a thei lo ahi hi.
Tanote aw, note' kiangah lai kong gelh hi. A hang pen na mawhnate uh ama' min hangin hong kimaisak ahih man hi.

Pate aw, note' kiangah lai kong gelh hi. A hang pen a kipatcil pana ompa na theih man uh ahi hi. Khangnote aw, note' kiangah lai kong gelh hi. A hang pen Gilopa zo khinzo na hih man uh ahi hi. Naupangte aw, note' kiangah lai kong gelh hi. A hang pen Pa na theih man uh ahi hi.

Pate aw, note' kiangah lai kong gelh hi. A hang pen a kipatcil pana ompa na theih man uh ahi hi. Khangnote aw, note' kiangah lai kong gelh hi. A hang pen note na thahat uh a, na sung uhah Pasian' kammal omkipin Gilopa zo khinzo na hih man uh ahi hi.
Leitung ahi-a leitung nate ahi zongin iplah kei un. Mi khatpeuh in leitung a iplah leh ama' sungah Pa' itna om lo hi.
A hang pen leitunga om nate khempeuh-cilesa lunggulhnate, mit tawh mu-a lunggulhnate leh neihlelam hanga kiphatsakna, cihte Pa' kiangpan hilo-in leitung pan ahi hi.
Leitung pen ama' lunggulhna teng tawh beilam a manawh hita a, Pasian' deihna a semte ahihleh a tawntungin omsuak ding uh hi.

Tate aw, tu-in hunlenai a nunungbel hita a, Khris-langneihmi hong tung ding ci-in na zaksa uh mah bangin tu-in zong Khris-langneihte tampi hong tung khinzo hi. Tua hangin zong hunlenai a nunungbel hita ahihlam a thei i hi hi.
Tua mite pen ei' kiangpana a paikhia uh hi a, ahi zongin tua hunin zong ei' pawl hi tuanlo uh hi. Hi uh hileh ei tawh hong omsuak ding uh hi. Ei' pawl ahihloh lam a kilat nadinga a paikhia uh ahi hi.
Note na hih uhleh Siangthopa' sathau nilhsa na hi uh a, na vekun thu na theitel uh hi.
Lai kong khak pen thumaan thutak na theih loh man uh hilo-in thei na hih man uh hizaw a, zuau thu pen thumaan thutak pan hong pai lo cih na thei uh hi.
Jesu pen Khris hilo ci-in a nial, zuauphuakpa kua ahi hiam? Khris-langneihmi hi a, Pa leh Tapa a nial mi ahi hi.
Tapa a nial peuhmah Pa a nial hi a, Tapa a sang peuhmah Pa a nei ahi hi.
A kipatcil pana na zak uh thu note' sungah omkipsak un. A kipatcil pana na zak uh thu note' sungah hong omkip leh note zong Tapa' sung leh Pa' sungah a omkip na hiding uh hi.
Tua hi a, eite' tunga hong kamciam pen tawntung nuntakna ahi hi.
Note a hong khem sawmte' thu, tu-a bangin lai tawh kong gelh hi.

Ahi zongin Khris' tungpana na san uh sathau nilhna thupha na sung uhah omkip ahih manin note hong hilh ding midang na kisam kei uh hi. Ama' sathau nilhna in note na khempeuh hong hilh mah bangin tuate thumaan hi a, zuau thu kihel lo hi. Hong hilh khin ahih mah bangin ama' sungah omkip un.
Tu-in tanote aw, amah hong kilat ciangin sunglam kimuanna i neih nading leh ama' hong paikik ciangin a maizum i hihloh nadingin ama' sungah omkip un.
Amah midik hi ci-in na tel uhleh diktatna tawh a sem a bawl khempeuh Pasian' sungpana suak ahihlam na thei ding uh hi.
